name: OPLS-AA 2024 rubber backbone refits (CAPS refit, QM)
source: CAPS fits to RI-MP2/cc-pVTZ//HF/6-31G** relaxed torsion scans (the OPLS-AA/L level) of rubber backbone fragments

dihedrals.name: CM-CM-CT-CT
dihedrals.comment: CAPS refit (QM), joint over the four diene scans with every barrier point (RI-MP2/cc-pVTZ//HF/6-31G**, 24 points each): RMS cis-polyisoprene 0.61, trans-polyisoprene 0.62, cis-polybutadiene 0.42, polychloroprene 0.76 kcal/mol; OPLS-AA 2024's own CM-CM-CT-CT on the same scans 1.65, 1.66, 1.36, 0.83

dihedrals.name: CT-CT-CT-CZ
dihedrals.comment: CAPS refit (QM) of nitrile butadiene rubber's CT-CT-CT-CZ (RI-MP2/cc-pVTZ//HF/6-31G**, 24 points): RMS 0.25 kcal/mol; OPLS-AA 2024's own 0.73

notes: An opt-in overlay on oplsaa2024 (caps ff apply --ff oplsaa2024 --overlay oplsaa2024-rubber-refit.json): it replaces OPLS-AA 2024's own values for these classes; the base library is unchanged.

CM-CM-CT-CT: one set of V1-V4 fitted jointly to the cis-1,4-polyisoprene, trans-1,4-polyisoprene, cis-1,4-polybutadiene and polychloroprene backbone scans (one constant per scan); RMS 0.32 / 0.43 / 0.38 / 0.45 kcal/mol against OPLS-AA 2024's own 0.55 / 0.78 / 1.00 / 0.82.
CT-CT-CT-CZ: the nitrile side of NBR (2-methylbutanenitrile-like fragment); RMS 0.25 kcal/mol against OPLS-AA 2024's own 0.73.
Not refitted, as OPLS-AA 2024's own values already follow QM: CT-CT-CT-CT in EPDM (0.30) and polyisobutylene (0.16), CA-CA-CT-CT at the styrene unit of SBR (0.28).
